checks: 1260: The notes state the class generates 2,100 EUR/month with 14 students, which gives 150 EUR/student/month. Losing 6 students implies 6 × 150 = 900 EUR/month, not 1,260. The figure 1,260 would correspond to 6 × 210, treating the total monthly revenue as a per-student amount, which is incorrect arithmetic on the notes.
